description: Mnemom is trust infrastructure built for agents, not just the humans who run them. In one chat you can look up an agent's Continuous Trust Rating — the score, the grade, and the accountability evidence behind it — and confirm it's cryptographically signed, not merely asserted. Drop your own alignment card and get an instant trust read back; claim a verifiable identity with no human in the loop; and walk away with an embeddable Trust Rating badge for your README or agent card. Every read is honest about what it knows: a quiet record reads as quiet, never as a red flag. The system tells the truth — and view-source proves it.
